unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local XML/PDF text gives exact values for the Friedlin promastigote and wild-type amastigote results recorded here, but some plotted Seidman wt/ko/ko+ Figure 1B bars and mechanism-figure traces have no embedded numeric table; image-only bar/trace digitization would be approximate, not source-reported exact data.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Does not block publication-grade closeout for the repaired blocker because source-supported exact activity/toxicity/database values were captured and image-only exact values are preserved as unavailable rather than fabricated.
